findings.after: IssueStatus includes 'blocked' and CreateIssue STATUSES is [backlog, todo, in_progress, blocked, done], allowing initial Blocked selection.
findings.before: IssueStatus and CreateIssue STATUSES were backlog, todo, in_progress, done (cancelled only in detail); Blocked could not be chosen at creation.
findings.description: Users can create a new issue directly in Blocked status. The Create Issue status selector now includes 'blocked' alongside backlog, todo, in_progress and done.
findings.confidenceReason: Patch directly adds blocked to type and CreateIssue constant

findings.after: IssueDetail STATUSES is [backlog, todo, in_progress, blocked, done, cancelled], enabling transition to Blocked.
findings.before: IssueDetail STATUSES were backlog, todo, in_progress, done, cancelled with no Blocked option.
findings.description: Users can change an existing issue to Blocked via the Issue Detail status control, which now lists blocked as a selectable status.
findings.confidenceReason: Patch directly inserts blocked into IssueDetail constant

findings.after: STATUS_LABELS blocked is 'Blocked' and StatusIcon renders a custom blocked SVG (circle + line) with stroke color.
findings.before: No STATUS_COLORS/LABELS/icon handling for blocked; other statuses had defined colors/icons.
findings.description: Blocked has a distinct visual: red (#dc2626) icon rendered as a circle with a horizontal line, aria-labeled 'Blocked' via STATUS_LABELS.
findings.confidenceReason: Patch adds label and conditional SVG branch for blocked

findings.after: STATUS_ORDER inserts blocked second; API docs list blocked and SQL CASE uses WHEN 'blocked' THEN 1, WHEN 'todo' THEN 2, etc.
findings.before: STATUS_ORDER was in_progress, todo, backlog, done, cancelled; API status filter listed todo, in_progress, done, backlog, cancelled and ORDER BY had no blocked (todo=1).
findings.description: Grouped issue display and API filtering/sorting now include Blocked ordered second after In Progress. Client STATUS_ORDER is in_progress, blocked, todo, backlog, done, cancelled and server ORDER BY places blocked at 1.
findings.confidenceReason: Both client order and server query patches show insertion of blocked

observations: Issue detail view for TASK-1 titled DocSyde runtime verification is visible.
Right sidebar contains a STATUS field with its value obscured, showing no legible status text.
No Blocked text or red circle-line icon is legibly visible in the viewport.
limitations: Status value is covered by black redaction, preventing verification that it is set to Blocked.
Status dropdown is not expanded, so selectable status options are not observable in viewport.
Icon color, shape, and aria-label cannot be verified from visible pixels alone.

Circle with horizontal line status icon in Blocked issue row

Remaining group headers Backlog, Done, Cancelled after Todo

observations: Blocked group shows count 1 and is ordered second directly after In Progress group.
One issue labeled TASK-1 DocSyde runtime verification appears under the Blocked group.
Visible group order is In Progress, Blocked, Todo, Backlog, Done, Cancelled.
In Progress, Todo, Backlog, Done and Cancelled groups each show 0 with No issues text.
Blocked header and its issue row each show a small circular icon with horizontal line.

Exact icon color hex, aria-label, STATUS_LABELS, STATUS_ORDER codes and server ORDER BY are not determinable from pixels alone.

Configured inspection scope (issue-status): Issue status selector and issue list grouped by status. Workflow can select Blocked and show its grouped row.
